objective: Develop degradation-conditioned MERIT branches for the six C009 OOD families while preserving exact identity behavior.

scientific_boundary.c009: The completed C009 verdict remains immutable and is used only as an unblinded development benchmark.
scientific_boundary.training: Only the original C006/C009 training split may be used for optimization.
scientific_boundary.confirmation: A parent-disjoint C010 source cohort with newly frozen OOD draws is reserved for one-shot confirmation after development is frozen.
scientific_boundary.field: The released v2.4 field route remains unchanged unless a later field endpoint confirms non-inferiority.

routing.saturation_clipping: parameter-conditioned inverse below the clipped plateau with conservative plateau reconstruction
routing.spatially_varying_blur: parameter-conditioned bounded spatially varying unsharp branch
routing.poisson_gaussian: NAFNet branch fine-tuned from the frozen C009 base using signal-dependent Poisson-Gaussian training draws
